get_single_model_color: create a function that gets the average vertex color from a trimesh mesh or returns a default green color
use_RenderType_enum: use the RenderType enum to specify rgb, depth, normal, or mask rendering output types
inherit_RendererBase: build a custom renderer class that inherits from RendererBase and implements add_object_model, render_object_model, and render_meshes
implement_add_object_model: implement the add_object_model method to register a 3D mesh with an optional color into the renderer
implement_render_meshes: implement the render_meshes method to render a list of trimesh meshes from a camera viewpoint with specified render types
